description: This source file defines the class 'ModifySubjectSubstitutionStrategy', which handles substitution logic for 'Subject' identifiers within 'ModifySubject' commands in the Eclipse Ditto project. It applies a substitution algorithm to the subject ID and potentially creates a new 'ModifySubject' object with the substituted ID.

classes.name: ModifySubjectSubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: Handles substitution for Subject IDs inside a ModifySubject command by applying a substitution algorithm and creating a new command if the ID changes.

methods.name: ModifySubjectSubstitutionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the class type 'ModifySubject'.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the substitution algorithm to the subject ID within a 'ModifySubject' object; returns an updated 'ModifySubject' with the substituted ID if it differs.
